description: This file defines the 'Price' entity class for the pricing domain in a Java application, using JPA annotations for ORM mapping to the 'prices' database table. It encapsulates properties related to product pricing, including regular and sale prices, sale timing, store and SKU identifiers, and active status.

classes.name: Price
classes.description: Entity class representing a price record with fields for store code, SKU, currency, regular and sale prices, sale timing, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the price record.

methods.name: getStoreCode
methods.description: Returns the store code associated with the price.

methods.name: setStoreCode
methods.description: Sets the store code for the price.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the price is active.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on store code, SKU, and currency.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on store code, SKU, and currency.
